title: Plan sequence per multi-subscription account
prompt: For accounts that have had more than one subscription, list the plan_ids they held, in the order they started.
population: Accounts with more than one subscription.
grain: One row per account, holding an ordered list.
referenceSql: SELECT account_id, array_agg(plan_id ORDER BY started_at) AS plan_sequence FROM subscriptions GROUP BY account_id HAVING count(*) > 1
